activeSlice.scope: Instrument Hunter V1 shadow comparability failures with exact fail-closed field/value diagnostics so the remaining 3x3 blocker can be identified without weakening any readiness or rollout threshold.
successCriteria: Comparability failures identify each failed field among evidenceCount, modelInvocationCount, criticalDependencyDegraded and costUsd.
Failure diagnostics include measured field values plus latency, recommendation count, workspace and Brand identifiers.
The comparability predicate itself remains unchanged.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
The same 3x3 pre-gate is rerun on the exact merge SHA before any 30-pair gate.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: The paired batch failed Hunter V1 comparability after three substantive cohort preflights, but the existing exception did not identify which comparability field failed.
